name: Nurse no Obenkyou Ouyou Hen ~Uke Shichu Igai wa Zettai Kinshi!~
original_name: ナースのお勉強 応用編～受けシチュ以外は絶対禁止！～
source:
The second semester in a nursing school with boarding system begins. Main character is a boy who aims to become a nurse with impure motive to create a harem as the only male there. As soon as he gets allowed to live in girls dormitory, air becomes filled with scent of lust.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-april-2008-gouen-no-soleil.html]vndbreview[/url]]
